page.title: Accounts
page.subtitle: Where the money sits — bank, cash, owner-paid, deposits — plus transfers, capital and loans

stats.cashBankSub: Per currency — never converted or added together

unclassified.title: {count, plural, one {# movement need classifying} other {# movements need classifying}}
unclassified.description: Money moved but we don't know why yet — mark it as capital, a loan or a repayment; bank interest as income; a fee or card charge as an expense.

account.emptyAdmin: No accounts yet. Add your first one above.

loans.title: Loans
loans.description: Money lent to the company. Outstanding = received − repaid.

movements.title: Transfers, capital & loans
movements.description: Money moving between accounts or financing the company. None of it touches profit & loss.
movements.empty: Nothing yet. Record a transfer, capital contribution or loan above.
movements.reversePrompt: Reverse this posted movement? Give the reason — then record the correct one.
movements.deleteConfirm: Delete this movement? A transfer deletes both sides.

toast.classifiedIncome: Classified as income — it's now in the ledger
toast.classifiedExpense: Classified as an expense — it's now in the ledger

accountDialog.openingHelp: The balance on that date. Movements dated before it are treated as already included.
accountDialog.openingHelpOwner: For an owner account: negative = the company owes the owner; positive = the owner holds company money.
accountDialog.active: Active (inactive accounts are hidden from pickers but keep their history)

transferDialog.intro: Moves money between your own accounts. It never counts as income or expense.
transferDialog.exactFigures: Use the exact figures from the bank statement.

movementDialog.financingHelp: Financing — not income or expense. It changes the account balance but never your profit.
movementDialog.noLoans: No {currency} loans — add one with “New loan”
movementDialog.pnlHelpIncome: Income — it moves to the ledger and counts in profit & loss. Its evidence and tax review start as pending.
movementDialog.pnlHelpExpense: An expense — it moves to the ledger and counts in profit & loss. Its evidence and tax review start as pending.
movementDialog.noIncomeCategories: No income categories — add one in Settings → Categories
movementDialog.noExpenseCategories: No expense categories — add one in Settings → Categories
movementDialog.interestNoCategory: This looks like bank interest, but there is no income category for it. Add one named “Bank interest” in Settings → Categories, then classify this.

loanDialog.title: New loan
loanDialog.help: Then record money received and repayments against it — the outstanding amount is calculated for you.
loanDialog.currencyFixed: {count, plural, one {Fixed — # movement uses this loan.} other {Fixed — # movements use this loan.}}

select.empty: No accounts — an admin adds them on the Accounts page

errors.locked: This is posted — reverse it from the ledger entry instead of editing.
errors.bankMatched: This is matched to a bank statement line. {problem} Unmatch it on the Bank page first.
errors.currencyLocked: This account already has movements, so its currency can't change.
errors.chooseMovementKind: Choose what kind of movement this is.
errors.invalidAmountDate: Enter a valid amount and date.
errors.chooseLoan: Choose which loan this belongs to.
errors.loanCurrency: That loan is in {currency} — use a {currency} account.
errors.negativeOpening: A {type} account can't have a negative opening balance — enter 0 or more. Only an owner account can be negative (the company owes the owner).
errors.loanNotFound: This loan no longer exists — reload the page.
errors.loanCurrencyLocked: {count, plural, one {# movement is recorded against this loan, so its currency stays {currency}.} other {# movements are recorded against this loan, so its currency stays {currency}.}} To use another currency, add a new loan.
errors.loanInUse: {count, plural, one {This loan can't be deleted: # movement is recorded against it.} other {This loan can't be deleted: # movements are recorded against it.}} Move them to another loan or delete them first.
errors.alreadyClassified: This movement is already classified — reload the page to see it.
errors.incomeNeedsMoneyIn: This money went out of the account, so it can't be income. Choose Expense (e.g. a fee or card charge), or a loan repayment.
errors.expenseNeedsMoneyOut: This money came into the account, so it can't be an expense. Choose Income (e.g. bank interest or a refund), capital or a loan.
errors.chooseIncomeCategory: Choose an income category (e.g. Bank interest). If none fits, add one in Settings → Categories.
errors.chooseExpenseCategory: Choose an expense category (e.g. Bank fees). If none fits, add one in Settings → Categories.
errors.categoryIsExpense: “{name}” is an expense category — choose an income category.
errors.categoryIsIncome: “{name}” is an income category — choose an expense category.
errors.changedMeanwhile: Someone changed this entry while you were editing it (reviewed, rejected or deleted it). Nothing was saved — reload the page to see it, then try again.

fx.vndSettled: Enter the VND amount actually settled.
fx.noDefaultRate: There is no default {currency} rate — enter the VND actually settled, or the rate.
